new_or_materially_strengthened_atoms.finding: HeadPolicy has one mechanical tier source of truth and evaluate_head resolves dependencies from a central DAG. Unknown heads, COMPUTE_OFF heads, and heads tainted by a noncomputable dependency return status=NOT_COMPUTED with value=null before compute_fn is called. OUTPUT_OFF is a distinct egress state rather than a fabricated negative observation.

Keep policy authority outside model text and expose the state through the Cognitive Twin.

new_or_materially_strengthened_atoms.finding: RealtimeSession stores model-emitted function calls as pending calls and clears them instead of dispatching when the parent response is cancelled or barge-in synchronizes an interrupted turn. Completed responses dispatch pending calls. This is a concrete pre-dispatch cancellation boundary.
new_or_materially_strengthened_atoms.grid10_delta: Generalize this into typed parent-causal invalidation: an EffectCandidate or tool proposal must carry parent cycle/turn/generation identity and becomes NON_DISPATCHABLE if that parent is cancelled, superseded, or generation-stale before EffectGate dispatch.
new_or_materially_strengthened_atoms.hard_boundary: This does not solve unknown outcome after an external request has already been submitted. Once dispatch may have occurred, outcome remains UNKNOWN until effect-specific verification; never blindly replay.
open_questions: Add Triggerword-4 tests for cancellation before dispatch, cancellation racing with dispatch, and transport loss after submission.
Bind pending-call identity to the same immutable invocation identity used by EffectRequest/EffectDecision/ExecutionReceipt.
